source: Item names compiled from the fan-made Elden Ring Wiki (eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com), cross-checked against the Elden Ring Fandom wiki, October 2026. Covers the base game, the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion and the Tarnished Pack (August 2026). Coverage checked against the item names in the game's own data files (soulsmods Paramdex).
note: Each slot lists [name, type, icon]. Elden Ring's Head, Chest, Arms and Legs slots map to "headgear", "chest", "gloves" and "legs". "weapons" is used for the armament, talisman and Ash of War slots, and includes shields, catalysts (staves and seals), talismans and Ashes of War. Altered armor variants are listed separately with "Altered" at the end of the name. Elden Ring has no boots or cloak slot, so there is no "boots" or "cloak" list. Unobtainable cut items are not included. No icons yet.
